signature.name: VTask.integer
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> [CommRing R] -> [IsDedekindDomain R] -> (S : Set (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R)) -> (K : Type v) -> [Field K] -> [Algebra R K] -> [IsFractionRing R K] -> Subalgebra R K

conventions.statement: When S is empty, VTask.integer S K equals the integral closure of R in K (which is R itself when R is integrally closed, as a Dedekind domain is).
conventions.note: Every height-one prime lies outside the empty set, so all valuation conditions are imposed.

conventions.statement: When S contains every height-one prime, the membership condition is vacuous and VTask.integer S K equals all of K.
conventions.note: No prime lies outside S, so no valuation constraint is imposed.

conventions.statement: The image of R under algebraMap R K is always contained in VTask.integer S K for any S, since elements of R have valuation ≤ 1 at every height-one prime.
conventions.note: This is witnessed by the algebraMap_mem' field of the Subalgebra structure.
